blurb: Guests can take private or group surf lessons, join teen and adult surf camps offered May through September, or rent surfboards. Lessons are available for ages 6 and up for private lessons, and group lessons for ages 12+ with a minimum weight and swimming skills. The business also offers large group bookings year-round with off-season discounts.
